[SWS_CM_00823] Default value of Minimum Send Interval and disabling Mini- mum Send Interval monitoring for Methods
⌈
If the configured Minimum Send Inter-
val (ServiceInterfaceDeploymentElement.minimumSendInterval) of a Re-
quest&Response or Fire&Forget method has the value 0, the Minimum Send Inter-
val monitoring shall not be active for the method and its corresponding operator
(), i.e., ara::com will not limit the Tx frequency by dropping method calls by the
client.
For each Field of a ServiceInterfaceDeployment, 0 shall be the de-
fault value for the corresponding ServiceInterfaceDeploymentElement.mini-
mumSendInterval. This means that unless ServiceInterfaceDeploymentEle-
ment.minimumSendInterval for a given method is explicitly configured to be > 0,
the Tx rate is not limited by ara::com.
⌋
